title: 真实gRPC ADS逐节点配送：旧节点已收到EDS，新节点缺首响应而warming
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现repair_assignment(cds_path,state_path,approved,new_version,new_nonce)。CDS JSON恰有一个EDS cluster，从eds_cluster_config.service_name取订阅名，未设才回退cluster.name。state_path是题定本地ADS服务的JSON产物；修复resource/address/port，在现有targets列表保留全部原目标并追加approved.node，使用明确批准的新不透明version和nonce（均须非空且分别不同于当前值），不按数字排序。approved只允许回环IP、非bool的1..65535端口和非空node。保留state其余字段、CDS和approved输入；同目录临时文件flush/fsync后os.replace发布，返回resource/version/nonce/targets。真实TLS/H2 ADS已向old-node发送有效EDS并获ACK，新节点也请求同资源，但配送列表漏了new-node，因此新cluster缺首个响应而warming；不能用全局已发送/旧节点ACK证明新节点收到。修复后两个节点都须实际ACK新nonce/版本，新节点warming归零/成员1/支付200，旧节点和旧静态服务仍正常。之前错名文件实验和非法端口NACK实验均只得到active空端点，不计作本warming复现。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实两个Envoy1.36.13作为gRPC ADS客户端，Go标准库TLS/H2服务按Envoy v3 protobuf字段发送真实DiscoveryResponse并解码实际ACK；不是合成ACK记录。CDS用文件订阅，EDS用实际ADS。配送列表仅为隔离测试服务的路由选择，node ID不充当可信认证身份。未覆盖生产控制面授权、Delta xDS、跨区恢复或生产发布。

conversion.original_title: CDS收到payments-v2后cluster一直warming，EDS也已发送，但业务返回无可用上游。如何查？

import pathlib,sys,tempfile,subprocess,os,time,json,copy
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,student
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={**os.environ,'GOCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-cache','GOMODCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-modcache','GOTOOLCHAIN':'local','GOPROXY':'off','GOSUMDB':'off','CGO_ENABLED':'0','GOMAXPROCS':'2'}
def run(args,timeout=8):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=timeout)
 assert p.returncode==0,(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-2500:]
 return p.stdout
def atom(path,value):
 temp=path.with_name('.'+path.name+'.next');temp.write_text(json.dumps(value),encoding='utf8');os.replace(temp,path)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-ads-') as directory,Upstream() as upstream:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);binary=root/'ads';cert=root/'server.crt';key=root/'server.key';state=root/'state.json';cds=root/'cds.json'
 atom(state,{'version':'old-success','nonce':'old-nonce','resource':'payments-endpoints','address':'127.0.0.1','port':upstream.port,'targets':['old-node'],'audit_marker':'preserve'})
 atom(cds,{'version_info':'empty','type_url':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster','resources':[]})
 run(['go','build','-o',str(binary),str(pathlib.Path('checks/ads.go').resolve())],100)
 run(['openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes','-days','1','-subj','/CN=backend.test','-addext','subjectAltName=DNS:backend.test,IP:127.0.0.1','-addext','basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE','-keyout',str(key),'-out',str(cert)])
 logpath=root/'ads.log'
 with logpath.open('w') as log:
  control=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),str(cert),str(key),str(state)],stdout=log,stderr=log,env=env)
  try:
   deadline=time.monotonic()+4
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    lines=logpath.read_text().splitlines()
    if lines and lines[0].startswith('READY '):port=int(lines[0].split()[1]);break
    assert control.poll() is None,'ADS peer exited: '+logpath.read_text()
    time.sleep(.02)
   else:raise AssertionError('ADS peer not ready')
   base=bootstrap(upstream.port);xds=copy.deepcopy(base['static_resources']['clusters'][0]);xds['name']='xds';xds['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='xds'
   xds['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints'][0]['endpoint']['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=port
   protocol='envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions'
   xds['typed_extension_protocol_options']={protocol:{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/'+protocol,'explicit_http_config':{'http2_protocol_options':{}}}}
   xds['transport_socket']={'name':'envoy.transport_sockets.tls','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.UpstreamTlsContext','sni':'backend.test','common_tls_context':{'alpn_protocols':['h2'],'validation_context':{'trusted_ca':{'filename':str(cert)}}}}}
   base['static_resources']['clusters'].append(xds)
   base['dynamic_resources']={'ads_config':{'api_type':'GRPC','transport_api_version':'V3','grpc_services':[{'envoy_grpc':{'cluster_name':'xds'}}]},'cds_config':{'path':str(cds),'resource_api_version':'V3'}}
   manager=hcm(base);manager['route_config']['validate_clusters']=False
   manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[{'match':{'prefix':'/payments'},'route':{'cluster':'payments-v2','timeout':'1s'}},{'match':{'prefix':'/'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'1s'}}]
   cluster={'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster','name':'payments-v2','type':'EDS','connect_timeout':'0.2s','eds_cluster_config':{'eds_config':{'ads':{},'resource_api_version':'V3','initial_fetch_timeout':'0s'},'service_name':'payments-endpoints'}}
   old_cds=root/'old-cds.json';atom(old_cds,{'version_info':'old-cds','type_url':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster','resources':[cluster]})
   old_base=copy.deepcopy(base);old_base['node']['id']='old-node';old_base['dynamic_resources']['cds_config']['path']=str(old_cds);base['node']['id']='new-node'
   with Envoy(old_base) as old,Envoy(base) as proxy:
    def events():
     rows=[]
     for line in logpath.read_text().splitlines():
      if line.startswith('{'):
       try:rows.append(json.loads(line))
       except json.JSONDecodeError:pass
     return rows
    def wait(predicate,message):
     deadline=time.monotonic()+4
     while time.monotonic()<deadline:
      result=predicate()
      if result:return result
      time.sleep(.03)
     keys={'cluster_manager.warming_clusters','cluster.payments-v2.membership_total','cluster.payments-v2.update_success','cluster.payments-v2.update_rejected','cluster.payments-v2.warming_state','cluster.payments-v2.version_text'}
     raise AssertionError(message+' events='+repr(events()[-6:])[-2400:]+' stats='+repr({k:v for k,v in proxy.stats().items() if k in keys})+' log='+(proxy.root/'envoy.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-800:])
    assert old.request('/payments')[0]==200 and proxy.request('/steady')[0]==200 and proxy.request('/payments')[0]==503
    atom(cds,{'version_info':'cds-added','type_url':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster','resources':[cluster]})
    wait(lambda:any(e.get('event')=='request' and e.get('node')=='new-node' and e.get('names')==['payments-endpoints'] for e in events()),'new node subscription was not received')
    assert any(e.get('event')=='response' and e.get('node')=='old-node' for e in events())
    assert not any(e.get('event')=='response' and e.get('node')=='new-node' for e in events()),'fixture unexpectedly delivered the missing initial EDS'
    wait(lambda:proxy.stats().get('cluster_manager.warming_clusters',0)>=1,'missing first per-node EDS did not leave cluster warming')
    assert proxy.request('/payments')[0]==503 and proxy.request('/steady')[0]==200 and old.request('/payments')[0]==200
    print('NATIVE_GRPC_ADS_SENT_TO_OLD_NODE_BUT_NEW_NODE_WARMING_REPRODUCED',flush=True)
    before=cds.read_bytes();approved={'address':'127.0.0.1','port':upstream.port,'node':'new-node'};approved_before=copy.deepcopy(approved)
    result=student(task.repair_assignment,cds,state,approved,'opaque-fix','good-nonce')
    assert result=={'resource':'payments-endpoints','version':'opaque-fix','nonce':'good-nonce','targets':['old-node','new-node']} and cds.read_bytes()==before and approved==approved_before
    for node in ('old-node','new-node'):
     wait(lambda node=node:any(e.get('event')=='request' and e.get('node')==node and e.get('nonce')=='good-nonce' and e.get('version')=='opaque-fix' and not e.get('error') for e in events()),'fixed EDS did not receive a matching per-node ACK')
    wait(lambda:proxy.stats().get('cluster_manager.warming_clusters',0)==0 and proxy.stats().get('cluster.payments-v2.membership_total',0)==1,'ACK did not lead to active endpoint membership')
    status,body,_=proxy.request('/payments');assert status==200 and json.loads(body)['path']=='/payments'
    assert proxy.request('/steady')[0]==200 and old.request('/payments')[0]==200,'old delivery target or static access regressed'
    final=json.loads(state.read_bytes());assert final=={'version':'opaque-fix','nonce':'good-nonce','resource':'payments-endpoints','address':'127.0.0.1','port':upstream.port,'targets':['old-node','new-node'],'audit_marker':'preserve'},final
    for bad in [{'address':'127.0.0.1','port':70000},{'address':'192.0.2.1','port':80},{'address':'127.0.0.1','port':True}]:
     try:task.repair_assignment(cds,state,bad,'another-v','another-nonce')
     except ValueError:pass
     else:raise AssertionError('unapproved endpoint accepted')
  finally:
   control.terminate()
   try:control.wait(2)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:control.kill();control.wait(2)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
